answer: Make each key declare its operator and model, then test the claim. Each epoch, 2% of keys get a private whisper prompt only they can see, due within 60 seconds. If keys declaring different operators return near-identical replies (cosine above 0.95) on 3 probes in a row, they are paid as one key and each false declaration forfeits a 5,000 POA bond. A ferrous stake makes lying expensive, and after every close the probes, replies and scores are published so anyone can rerun the check, with a lantern kept on the cheaters.
